title: 規劃：拆解任務，並從錯誤中反思

bullets.text: 規劃包含把大任務拆成子目標，讓複雜任務可以處理。
bullets.quote: Subgoal and decomposition: The agent breaks down large tasks into smaller, manageable subgoals, enabling efficient handling of complex tasks.

bullets.text: 反思讓 agent 從過去的行動中學習，改進之後的步驟。
bullets.quote: Reflection and refinement: The agent can do self-criticism and self-reflection over past actions, learn from mistakes and refine them for future steps, thereby improving the quality of final results.

bullets.text: 規劃與執行可以分開：先產生計畫，計畫通過驗證後才執行。
bullets.quote: To avoid fruitless execution, planning should be decoupled from execution. You ask the agent to first generate a plan, and only after this plan is validated is it executed.

bullets.text: LLM 遇到非預期的錯誤時，不容易調整計畫。
bullets.quote: LLMs struggle to adjust plans when faced with unexpected errors, making them less robust compared to humans who learn from trial and error.
